Class LambdaAndReferenceTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.LambdaAndReferenceTck
public abstract class LambdaAndReferenceTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Lambdas and method references: the functional interface method they implement, the receiver they capture and the scope of the type variables they use.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3

  • Method Details

    • referencesCaptureTheirReceiverBeforeItChanges

      @ParameterizedTest(name="a reference to a {0} receiver captures it before it changes, calling next() {1} time(s)") @CsvSource({"field, 0","local, 0","result, 1"}) public void referencesCaptureTheirReceiverBeforeItChanges(String kind, int receiverReads) throws Exception
      A bound method reference evaluates its receiver once, where it is created, so replacing the receiver later does not change what the reference calls. A receiver that is the result of a call is read exactly once.
      Parameters:
      kind - What the receiver is: a field, a local or the result of a call
      receiverReads - How many times creating the reference calls the method that returns the receiver
      Throws:
      Exception - If the generated program cannot be loaded or invoked
      Since:
      2.3

    • varargsReferenceBoundToAFieldCapturesItsValue

      @Test public void varargsReferenceBoundToAFieldCapturesItsValue() throws Exception
      A reference to a method of variable arity bound to a field - Function<String, String> f = this.format::formatted - reads the field once, where it is created: assigning the field afterwards does not change what the reference calls, and a null field fails where it is created.
      Throws:
      Exception - If the generated class cannot be used
      Since:
      2.3
